title: Exploration of anti-atherosclerotic activity of 1,8-cineole through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo efficacy studies in high-fat-diet-induced atherosclerosis in hamsters.
authors: Savla, Shreya R; Bhatt, Lokesh Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究1,8-桉叶素抗动脉粥样硬化活性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The anti-atherogenic potential of liver X receptors (LXRs) has been attributed to their inhibitory role in macrophage-mediated inflammation and promotion of reverse cholesterol transport. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of an LXR agonist, 1,8-cineole (Eucalyptol), in atherosclerosis through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo efficacy studies in high-fat-diet-induced atherosclerosis in hamsters. Network pharmacology analysis was performed by identifying potential targets of 1,8-Cineole and atherosclerosis, followed by the construction of component-target-disease and protein-protein interaction networks. Gene Ontology and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of targets were performed. The top 5 targets were selected for molecular docking studies. Atherosclerosis was induced in male Golden Syrian hamsters, and the results of network pharmacology were verified. Fifty-one overlapped targets were identified for 1,8-cineole and atherosclerosis. In the protein-protein interaction studies, the top 5 ranked proteins were PPARG, FXR, ABCA-1, ABCG1, and LXRAlpha. KEGG pathway analysis and molecular docking showed that ABCA-1 and LXRAlpha were correlated in atherosclerosis. Animal studies showed amelioration of atherosclerotic lesions in the aorta of animals treated with 1,8-cineole compared to disease control aortas. A dose-dependent attenuation in ABCA-1 levels and inflammatory markers was observed in animals treated with 1,8-cineole, comparable to its levels in normal animals. In conclusion, 1,8-cineole showed anti-atherosclerotic effects in Golden Syrian hamsters via LXRAlpha-induced ABCA-1 overexpression.
abstract_zh: 肝X受体（liver X receptors, LXRs）的抗动脉粥样硬化潜力归因于其在巨噬细胞介导的炎症中的抑制作用及对反向胆固醇转运的促进。本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接及高脂饮食诱导的仓鼠动脉粥样硬化体内疗效研究，评估LXR激动剂1,8-桉叶素（1,8-cineole, Eucalyptol）在动脉粥样硬化中的功效。网络药理学分析通过识别1,8-桉叶素和动脉粥样硬化的潜在靶点进行，随后构建成分-靶点-疾病及蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。对靶点进行了基因本体论（Gene Ontology）和KEGG通路富集分析。选取前5个靶点进行分子对接研究。在雄性金黄地鼠（Golden Syrian hamsters）中诱导动脉粥样硬化，并验证网络药理学结果。共识别出1,8-桉叶素和动脉粥样硬化的51个重叠靶点。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用研究中，排名前5的蛋白质为PPARG、FXR、ABCA-1、ABCG1和LXRAlpha。KEGG通路分析和分子对接显示，ABCA-1和LXRAlpha在动脉粥样硬化中相关。动物研究表明，与疾病对照主动脉相比，经1,8-桉叶素处理的动物主动脉中动脉粥样硬化病变得到改善。在经1,8-桉叶素处理的动物中，观察到ABCA-1水平和炎症标志物的剂量依赖性减弱，与正常动物水平相当。总之，1,8-桉叶素通过LXRAlpha诱导的ABCA-1过表达在金黄地鼠中显示出抗动脉粥样硬化效应。
